encounters.scenario: A customer buys a specific wired mouse. The salesperson provides the requested item without suggesting any extras or upgrades.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Hello, sir. What are you looking for?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Do you have the Logitech B100 wired mouse? I need one in black.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Yes, black is available. One minute, I'll get it from the shelf.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: What's the price?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: It's ₹349, including GST.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: This has the regular USB connector, right? Not Type-C?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Correct, sir. It has a USB-A connector. You can see it here on the box.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Okay, that's the one I need. Please bill it.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Sure. How would you like to pay?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: UPI. Shall I scan this code on the counter?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Yes, that one. The amount is ₹349.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Done. It's showing successful.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Received, sir. Here's your mouse and the bill.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Thank you.

encounters.notes: The salesperson only supplies the exact item requested, answers price and connector questions, and completes payment. No additional products, upgrades, or paid services are offered.

encounters.scenario: A customer shopping for a phone asks, 'Anything else good?' The salesperson shows another phone within the original budget and requirements, without offering extras or an upgrade.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Hello, sir. What are you looking for?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: A phone for my father. Under twenty thousand, mainly calls, WhatsApp and some videos.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Okay. Any particular brand, or shall I show you something with a bigger screen?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Brand is flexible. Yes, a big screen and decent battery. Nothing complicated.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: This one is eighteen thousand five hundred. Here's the display piece. You can check the screen and how it feels in the hand.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Screen looks fine, but it's a little heavy. Anything else good?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Yes, this other model is nineteen thousand. It's lighter, and the screen is almost the same size. Have a look.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: This feels better. Can the text be made bigger?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Yes, sir. Under display settings, you can increase the font size like this.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Good. And nineteen thousand is the final price, including GST?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Yes, including GST. That's the price for the phone.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Okay, I'll take this one. Do you have it in black?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Yes, black is available. I'll bring a sealed box. Shall I make the bill in your name?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Yes, please. I'll give you the details.

encounters.notes: The customer's 'Anything else good?' explicitly requests another phone option. Showing a slightly higher-priced alternative within the stated budget fulfills that request; it is not a proactive upsell. No additional products, services or upgrades are offered.

encounters.scenario: A customer buying a laptop accepts an optional laptop bag and wireless mouse bundle offered at a discounted price.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Hello sir, kya dikhaun aapko?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Office work ke liye laptop chahiye. Excel, video calls, bas normal use hai. Budget forty-five thousand tak hai.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Yeh wala dekh lijiye sir. Sixteen GB RAM, five-twelve GB SSD hai. Aapke kaam ke liye sahi rahega, price forty-two thousand nine ninety hai.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Keyboard try kar sakta hoon? Kaafi typing rehti hai meri.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Haan bilkul, baith ke check kar lijiye. Yeh document khula hai, ismein type karke dekh sakte hain.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Haan, comfortable hai. Theek hai, yehi laptop le leta hoon.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Sir, iske saath laptop bag aur wireless mouse ka optional combo bhi hai. Alag se bag twelve ninety-nine aur mouse seven ninety-nine ka hai. Laptop ke saath dono lenge toh fourteen ninety-nine mein padenge, five ninety-nine bach jayenge. Add kar doon?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Bag dikhao zara. Aur combo mila ke final kitna hoga?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Yeh raha bag, laptop is padded section mein aayega. Laptop aur combo mila ke forty-four thousand four eighty-nine hoga, GST included.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Achha, budget ke andar hi hai. Bag bhi theek lag raha hai. Haan, mouse aur bag wala combo add kar do.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Ji sir. Bill kis naam se banana hai?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Rahul Sharma. Payment card se karunga.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Sure sir. Bill mein laptop aur discounted combo dono listed hain. Total forty-four thousand four eighty-nine hai. Machine pe amount check karke card insert kar dijiye.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Haan, amount sahi hai. Payment ho gaya, bill bag mein rakh dena please.

encounters.notes: Turn 7 is the single proactive upsell: a discounted bag-and-mouse bundle added to the laptop purchase. The customer accepts in turn 10. Showing the requested laptop, answering the bundle-price question, and confirming the bill are not additional upsell attempts.
